entries.example: Are you going to school? Take your books. (from here to the school)
Are you going to the kitchen? Can you bring me a glass? (from the kitchen to here)
It's raining. You can take my umbrella and bring it back tomorrow.

note: This unit has no formal vocabulary table; the left page presents bring/take with definitions and examples in sections A–C. Entries above are the printed presentation items; no POS markers or IPA are printed.
